name: Baruch
summary: Baruch son of Neriah was a scribe who wrote down the LORD's words as Jeremiah spoke them. He read the scroll aloud in the LORD's house and wrote it all again after the king burned it.

key_moments.title: Keeping the Deed
key_moments.description: When Jeremiah bought a field, he gave the sealed and open copies of the deed to Baruch before witnesses. He told Baruch to put them in a clay jar so they would last many days.

key_moments.title: Writing and Reading the Scroll
key_moments.description: Baruch wrote down every word of the LORD as Jeremiah spoke it. Since Jeremiah could not go, Baruch read the scroll to everyone in the LORD's house, by the entry to the new gate.

key_moments.title: Writes the Scroll Again
key_moments.description: After the king burned the scroll, the LORD told Jeremiah to take another one. Baruch wrote in it every word of the first, and many more like them were added.

key_moments.title: Told Not to Seek Great Things
key_moments.description: Baruch had cried that the LORD had added grief to his sorrow. The LORD told him not to seek great things for himself, but promised to keep him alive wherever he went.
